feature_origin.qualification: track_feats is relatively independent of the classification vector only. Shared backbone/training, possible track-head initialization, and selection by a tracker using fused classification/location remain. Neither feature is independent noise. Inactive OVTrackRoISLAck additions are not attributed to this run. Source inspection describes current preserved code, not an instrumented historical execution trace.

protocol.geometry_matching: For each image, maximize the sum of raw bbox IoUs with a class-agnostic one-to-one Hungarian assignment, then retain assigned pairs with IoU >= threshold. No class, posterior, score or GT identity enters the assignment. This is independent diagnostic matching, not TETA's temporal alignment assignment.
protocol.classification: argmax of original p_fused foreground 296 columns for every emitted observation, before GT-based diagnostic selection; no candidate readout labels are generated
protocol.pairs: Every unordered pair of matched observations within each emitted predicted trajectory; no stochastic pair or track subsampling. Stable chronological pair enumeration resolves cosine ties deterministically.
protocol.strata: Same predicted trajectory, same identity-pair scope, unordered GT-class pair (diagnostic composition control), exact sampled frame_id lag for primary or lag bin for sensitivity, pair detector-score midrank-mean quartile and midrank absolute difference <=.25 versus >.25.
protocol.sampled_frame_id_lag: Difference in annotated sampled frame_id, not raw video frame number or seconds. Sensitivity bins 1-2, 3-5, 6-10, 11+.
protocol.score_control: Detector scores are tiny and are not treated as calibrated reliability. Midranks (average 1-based rank-.5)/n use ALL emitted observations of that trajectory, including unmatched observations. Pair mean-rank quartiles have cutpoints .25,.50,.75; rank difference cutpoint .25.
protocol.posterior_sensitivity: binned_lag_score_rank_posterior_max additionally bins pair mean of max original foreground p_fused into [0,.1),[.1,.3),[.3,.6),[.6,1] and absolute difference <=.1 versus >.1. These are the approved boundaries, independently rerun to correct the earlier quartile/.25 implementation deviation; primary exact-lag and score-rank controls are unchanged.
protocol.selection: Require >=6 pairs per stratum; select floor(n/3) smallest cosine as far and the same number largest cosine as near, independently for track_feats and cls_feats. All available pairs and all pairs in supported strata retain separate baseline denominators.
protocol.same_wrong: Both endpoints predict a class different from their own GT class AND predict the same category. For different GT classes this is a shared wrong third class, not merely an identity switch.
protocol.baseline_error_prevalence: Mean of the two endpoint error indicators over ALL pairs in the stated denominator; both-wrong and prediction agreement are also reported. same_wrong_given_both_wrong is conditional and uses its own denominator.
protocol.per_class_weight: Each pair contributes half weight to each endpoint GT class; same-class pairs therefore contribute one. Unsupported comparisons are null, never zero. Equal-class means use supported classes only.
protocol.equal_track_and_class_means: For every pair partition, first pool its selected far/near pairs within each supported predicted track or endpoint GT class, compute near-minus-far rates, then average those differences equally across supported units. Conditional same_wrong_given_both_wrong differences require both far and near both-wrong denominators to be nonzero and report their own support.
protocol.uncertainty: No pair-independent significance tests; pairs share trajectories. Differences and support are descriptive. Natural association is not causal and does not establish candidate efficacy.

role: Approved-boundary posterior-confidence sensitivity correction. Primary and lag-only controls are reproduced exactly, not new independent efficacy evidence.
interpretation_limits: Single-GT-ID means one GT identity among matched observations only; purity of unmatched trajectory segments is not established.
Descriptive repeated wrong-category association; not centered conditional residual covariance, a causal effect, or candidate efficacy.
Mixed-track scopes retain actual GT-identity-pair difficulty composition confounding.
